69013903.Title: 69013903_Title
69013903.Desc: · Whenever an Agent inflicts an Anomaly on the Boss, they apply 1 stack of Shadow to it. Each stack of Shadow increases the Boss's <color=#2BAD00>Anomaly DMG taken by 7.5%</color> and additionally increases its Vortex DMG taken <color=#2BAD00>by 5%</color> for <color=#2BAD00>10s</color>. Shadow can stack up to <color=#2BAD00>3 times</color>. The duration of each stack is calculated separately. During <Term:2000001>, applying Shadow to the Boss additionally reduces the <color=#FFAF2C>Corruptive Barrier</color> by <color=#2BAD00>20% of its max value</color> and accumulates <color=#2BAD00>15% Daze</color> (cannot be repeatedly triggered within 15s). When the <color=#FFAF2C>Corruptive Barrier</color> is broken, the Boss immediately gains max stacks of Shadow. When the Boss is Stunned, all Shadow stacks are removed and an equal number of Laceration stacks are applied. Each stack of Laceration reduces the Boss's <color=#2BAD00>Anomaly Buildup RES by 5%</color> and increases its <color=#2BAD00>Stun DMG Multiplier by 10%</color>. When the Boss's Stunned state ends, all Laceration stacks are removed.

69013904.Title: 69013904_Title
69013904.Desc: · Each successful parry against Girtablullu's consecutive downward smashes after it activates <Term:2000001> grants <color=#FFAF2C>1,000 Performance Points</color>. Successfully triggering a <color=#FFAF2C>Chain Parry</color> against the final slam grants an additional <color=#FFAF2C>1,000 Performance Points</color>. <color=#FFAF2C>Successfully breaking the Corruptive Barrier</color> grants <color=#FFAF2C>1,500 Performance Points</color>. Maximum obtainable Performance Points: 5,000.

69013901.Title: Northern Wind
69013901.Desc:
· Agent ATK <color=#2BAD00>increases by 10%</color>. After inflicting <color=#FFFFFF>Vortex</color> on an enemy, the whole squad's ATK <color=#2BAD00>increases by 5%</color>, and Anomaly Proficiency <color=#2BAD00>increases by 10</color>, lasting for 15s, stacking up to 3 times. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
· After inflicting a <color=#A6C5FD>Wind</color> or <color=#98EFF0>Ice</color> Attribute Anomaly on an enemy, the enemy's DEF <color=#2BAD00> decreases by 10%</color> for 20s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

69014001.Title: Huntdown
69014001.Desc:
· DMG dealt by Agents <color=#2BAD00>increases by 20%</color>, and CRIT DMG <color=#2BAD00>increases by 20%</color>.
· <color=#FFFFFF>Attack</color> specialty Agents' ATK <color=#2BAD00>increases by 10%</color>, DMG dealt by <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>/<color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color> <color=#2BAD00>increases by 20%</color>, and ignore <color=#2BAD00>10%</color> of enemies' DEF.

69014002.Title: Oblivion
69014002.Desc:
· Daze inflicted by the Agent increases by <color=#2BAD00>20%</color>. <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>/<color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> ignore <color=#2BAD00>30%</color> of the enemy's All-Attribute RES.
· After launching a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, the whole squad's ATK increases by <color=#2BAD00>10%</color> and CRIT DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>15%</color> for 20s, stacking up to 3 times. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

69012704.Desc: · Boss Anomaly DMG taken is <color=#2BAD00>reduced by 30%</color>. When switching from <Term:2000002> state to normal state, or from normal state to <color=#FFAF2C>Miasmic Shield</color> state, Agent CRIT DMG against them is <color=#2BAD00>increased by 20%</color>. This effect can stack up to 3 times and resets when the boss recovers from Stun.

69012705.Desc: ·Triggering <color=#FFAF2C>Miasmic Shield Purification</color> grants <color=#FFAF2C>1,000 Performance Points</color>. During the <Term:2000003>, each successful counter against the Boss's attacks grants <color=#FFAF2C>500 Performance Points</color>. Performing a <color=#FFAF2C>Shutdown</color> on the Boss's <color=#FFAF2C>Control Skill</color> grants <color=#FFAF2C>2,000 Performance Points</color>. Maximum obtainable Performance Points: 5,000.

69012604.Desc: · When Sobek and The Thrall alternate turns, The Thrall gains 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Contract</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Self-Sacrifice</color>. Contract and Self-Sacrifice can stack up to 3 times. Each stack of Contract increases All-Attribute Anomaly Buildup RES by <color=#FFAF2C>15%</color>, each stack of Self-Sacrifice increases The Thrall's Stun DMG Multiplier by <color=#FFAF2C>10%</color>. When The Thrall is Stunned, CRIT DMG taken increases by <color=#FFAF2C>50%</color>.
